hints.title: Equal One Partition Condition
hints.text: The total number of ones in s must be divisible by 3. If total ones modulo 3 is non-zero, return 0.

hints.title: All Zeros Special Case
hints.text: If s consists entirely of zeros, choose any 2 cut positions among the n - 1 available boundaries: (n - 1) * (n - 2) / 2.

hints.title: Ways to Place the Two Cuts
hints.text: With k = total // 3 ones per block, find the number of ways to cut between the kth and (k+1)th one, and between (2k)th and (2k+1)th one. Multiply their counts modulo 10^9 + 7.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all O(N^2) split pairs takes quadratic time, giving TLE for N = 10^5.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single pass counting ones and boundary zeros operates in O(N) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate applies combinatorial multiplication on zero gaps between consecutive equal-one blocks.
